dart.family: native goal reaching (reach_location policy), second goal at 5 s of 20 s

ardy.family: streaming root path: 8 directions x 3 speed profiles, text switch at 5 s
ardy.no_held_out_position: all 8 root-path directions were run and inspected in the 10-31 M0 experiments (seeds 20-24); held out only through seed 24

primal.family: unconditioned continuation from 24 initial states; one run writes all 8 geometric switch combinations

chois.family: official OMOMO test windows (first two eligible windows per object, native order; V2 tasks 0-23)

kimodo.tasks: reuse of the 416 deck pairs (E4), not extended

tasks.native_matrix: tasks 0-11 of every method are the native matrix tasks (reproduction subset, design section 2)
tasks.clock: paused only (约定，未经推演): the native matrix also ran DART, CLoSD and ARDY with a realtime clock; the batch does not
tasks.closd: CLoSD runs its native REACH state, a root-goal task: the goal is a ground point and the text is the state-machine constant "A person is walking." (baselines/CLoSD closd/env/tasks/closd_task.py lines 34-37); it gets 8 directions x 3 distances like DART and no risk-zone hand targets. Its only hand-target state is STRIKE_PUNCH (wrist target 1-1.5 m away, text "A person is punching with the * hand.", same file lines 42-45); hand targets through it would be a later extension, not this batch

reach_geometry.frame: position_m: report frame, Z up, metres; the body faces -Y and its right side is -X at frame 0 (utils/motiogen/task_geometry.py); origin: the method's initial pelvis joint projected on the floor. target_body_m: [forward, right, up] in the same frame. The nominal Rajagopal body stands for the pelvis joint with its hip-centre midpoint (convention, not derived; its pelvis origin is 5.6 cm ahead of that midpoint); in HumanML3D standing frames the pelvis joint is 1.2 cm ahead of the hip midpoint, so a method receives each target 1.2 cm further forward relative to its hips than the nominal check assumed (sensitivity: reachability_origin_shift_+0.012.json)
reach_geometry.horizontal_reach: 0.8 x arm length from the shoulder (约定), nominal Rajagopal body; front = straight ahead at the shoulder, side90 = lateral

overhead.rule: min over the flat limits (rajagopal and humanml, front and side90, both hands) - 0.05 m (convention, not derived), floored to mm
overhead.design_value_note: 1.95 m (design section 2, 约定) is above every flat-foot limit and was replaced

dataset_standing_median.note: shoulder_height_m / arm_length_m above are of the scaled Rajagopal model (torso scaled symmetrically); these are the HumanML3D joints themselves

overhead.humanml_body: HumanML3D test-set reference skeleton (4648 clips; standing-frame selection thresholds 约定) fitted by segment-wise scaling of the Rajagopal model, Rajagopal joint ranges kept (约定): develop_logs/test_runs/20261109_task_reachability/humanml_reference_body.json

elevation_check.reading: minimum over all reaching poses found (multi-start SLSQP, local): upper arm against the vertical >= 91.2 deg in front and 105.3 deg at the side, i.e. above 90; relative to the thorax (the RULA reading) the side stays above 90 (102.7) but in front a backward trunk lean reaches the target with 67.8 (right) / 76.1 (left) deg; the left-right asymmetry of a symmetric model shows the minimum is local, so the true thoracic minimum in front is at most 67.8 deg

shift_m.meaning: targets moved forward by this amount relative to the nominal origin (sensitivity check; flat only)

split.dimensions: target position, paraphrase, seed (design section 14 item 1)
split.rule: a row is held out if any of its dimensions is held out, except that a row whose input is identical to an already-run input (method, task input, seed, condition) is always development
split.held_out_positions: per method: 4 of the 12 added tasks, interleaved so that both sets cover every zone / direction / distance / speed / family level (methods.<m>.held_out_positions); ARDY and CHOIS have none (methods.<m>.no_held_out_position)
split.paraphrase_rotation: nested Latin square (user 2026-11-09): within each hand the 12 tasks are indexed i = 0..11 (native matrix tasks first, then the risk-zone tasks); seed s in 20-23 uses paraphrase (i + s - 20) mod 4, seed 24 uses paraphrase 4; the same paraphrase index applies to the neutral and the consistent text
split.primal: held out by resampling group (effective seed = initial_seed + initial_history): groups 9009 (tasks 15, 19) and 9011 (tasks 17, 21), both history lengths twice; no held-out initial state shares a history prefix with a development one (tasks 12, 13 share theirs with matrix tasks 10, 11)
split.enforcement: config/analysis_plan_20261108.json split_use: analysis scripts select development rows by this split and refuse held-out rows unless the final-comparison flag is given; the opening is recorded in the notes with time and commit

seeds_and_sizes.per_cell: every task x condition x text level with all 5 seeds; one run per row
seeds_and_sizes.primal: PRIMAL rows are runs; each run writes the 8 switch combinations (x 8 evaluation rows)

reuse.rule: an already-run row is reused only if its input is identical (method, task input, seed, condition, text) and its run meets contract layer 4 (scan state ok or legacy); otherwise it is generated again; identical-but-not-reusable rows (CLoSD: no rotations_xyzw; DART: no smplx_params) are regenerated and the old run is kept for reproduction

3_engineering.ram_budget: the RAM budget of the resource review (utils/motiogen/runtime.py budgets: min(ram_max, available - reserve)) is machine-wide, checked once at job start and not coordinated by the per-card lock; CHOIS (reviewed bound 10 GiB, reserve 6 GiB) was refused in both rounds (15.7 GiB available) and ran after the user freed memory (21.0 GiB); the queue does not retry a refused job
